releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.21 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Autonomous Ad Visual Learning Engine: automatically captures stuck ad frames after 8s and analyzes them in background
* Dual-Engine multimodal visual recognition with Room DB v2 persistent layout memory
* 1-Tap 'Report / Learn Stuck Ad' trigger added to Floating HUD bubble
* Learned Ad Memory gallery added to History Screen with thumbnail previews, coordinate markers, and re-analysis controls
* LRU screenshot storage bounded to 25 items (~3MB) with auto-recycling
